notes: All scenes are illustrative design fixtures, not runtime, a11y or cross-client proof. No agent, CI job, webhook, source record or Git state is changed by these links.

Canonical data is copied from base.json: project-factory/env-ws; PlanItemRef {kind:planned,environmentId:env-ws,projectId:project-factory,id:plan-237}; SourceRef github/acme/factory#237 revision3. Before W07, no retained WorkRef or native thread exists for #237. After Factory admission, retained WorkRef {version:1,environmentId:env-ws,kind:issue,id:8b42f1d3} links the original native root8b42f1d3. These identities are not interchangeable.

Seven companion project-local records are supplementary illustrative fixture data needed for a dense Table and four-column Board. They have PlanItemRefs and source links only, with no invented admission roots, invocation outcomes or native threads. Their planning stages do not imply execution.

Companion fixtures, all project-factory/env-ws: plan-brief-14 links Brief14 rev2; plan-research-7 links sealed Research7 rev1; plan-issue-231 links GitHub acme/factory#231 rev2; plan-feed-8 links RSS source rss-engineering item-8 rev1; plan-brief-15 links Brief15 rev1; plan-note-4 is local project note4 rev1; plan-issue-229 links GitHub acme/factory#229 rev1. None has execution in this study. Counts are this project query only, never all-environment counts.

C00 has seven planned records and two incoming issue revisions. #237 is absent from Work. C06 Add to plan creates plan-237 in Ready and removes the candidate revision from Needs triage without closing GitHub, claiming work, allocating a retained admission or starting an agent. C07 contains the remaining #238 candidate. Every post-add scene stays planned. No ordinary link returns C00/C05/C06 after that mutation.

The planning feature and resizable contextual panel are proposed #63. Four stages are project-owned Backlog, Ready, In progress and Done, not source or native task lifecycle states. C09 edits one field then exposes an explicit reverse. No board drag-to-start is modeled.

Layout switches C02/C03/C04 preserve exact PlanItemRef, source revision, project/environment, All planned filter and stage-order query. Cards, aligned table rows with separate Stage/Source/Execution columns, and compact stage-grouped list rows are different layouts of the same eight records.

C08 is a read-only source-owned review. Its return edge type back permits only C02/C03/C04, retaining originating view and selection; fixed Show selected Board is explicitly C02. Parent must create origin-specific inbound/return aliases if the prototype cannot resolve allowedOrigins. Never implement back from C07 across Add to plan.

All manual Run workflow controls navigate to canonical F5-W05. W05/W06 must retain collectionOrigin C02/C03/C04 through target changes and cancel. Configured Workflows navigation targets W03, never initialization W00. W03 Return to Work must preserve incoming snapshot, including C00/C01 pre/post planning and C10/C11/C12/C13/C14/C15 execution variants; no static C02 return may erase invocation associations.

Factory provider-working variants C10/C11/C12 link inv-f5-factory-01 and optional original issue root8b42f1d3. W07 is the historical accepted-dispatch receipt; its transition to these Work snapshots must be history-read and explicitly observe a later state. Open thread targets F5-P-THREAD-C10/C11/C12 respectively, each parent-owned W08 native thread body with exact origin return. Fresh W08 returns C10. Reading a historical dispatch receipt does not reset current provider state.

CI-only C14 queued and C15 completed link inv-f5-ci-01/external run19541, with no retained native Work or thread. W09 returns C14; W10 returns C15. C14 Observe CI completion is an explicit later-record study. Completion is not acceptance, source closure, merge or release. Source and stage remain Open/Ready.

Post-execution Intake and unsupported alternate layouts are intentionally omitted where they would restore an earlier snapshot. W03 and source-owner returns must preserve incoming state. A shell link is not permission to reset the selected source, plan, view or execution.

Parent owns all native sidebar/header/tabs/caption rendering, ordinary threads, source-owner menus/details, coordinator, Settings and final geometry/interaction checks. This JSON owns only x340..1580/y108..876 body regions in 1600x1040 frames. It assigns no Figma ids or placements.

Existing RSS/Atom Admit and start remains an execution launch in its source owner. Add to plan is a separate proposed operation; it does not replace or relabel admission. Own-forge Issues, human Briefs and sealed Research keep their source lifecycles and are exposed through source-owned entrypoints.

Independent owner verification is deferred: JSON schema/unique edge and region ids, all endpoint resolution and origin alias wiring, native-size geometry/text wrapping, rendering and actual-click paths. No author-side renderer, schema check, tests, formatter, browser/Figma authoring or application execution was run.

Automatic branch C13 preserves plan-237 Ready/no manual execution and selects distinct PlanItemRef plan-238 with GitHub#238 rev1, Implement issue v1 Factory and inv-f5-auto-01. Acceptance is not completion; no root is fabricated. It has nine planned project records and #238 has left Needs triage. C13 is a later-record branch, never an ordinary return that swaps the selected identity of plan-237.

Source-owner entrypoints are CE63 Issues / CE64 Briefs / CE65 Research from C00 and CE66 / CE67 / CE68 respectively from C01. Parent aliases F5-P-ISSUES/F5-P-BRIEFS/F5-P-RESEARCH must preserve the incoming complete Work origin and return read-only, never plan or launch. The parent owns source-specific authoring and admission commands.

Shell Intake links are omitted from C03/C04 and later execution states because this file does not model an Intake return with their selected-view snapshot. Source review C08 has only its explicit context-preserving Return to Work control and no shell Work reset. Omitting an unmodeled link is intentional, not an implicit permission to return to C02.
